plan: [This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction: winner pays the highest other bid. Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy and maximizes expected surplus regardless of others' strategies. No prior history; values are independent and single round. To maximize long-run profit, bid my true private value to avoid overbidding and ensure I win whenever paying less than my value. Therefore bid $25.]

[This is a sealed-bid second-price auction: the winner pays the highest other bid. In independent private-value settings, bidding my true value is a dominant strategy and maximizes expected payoff. No prior rounds to learn from. To maximize long-run profit (and immediate expected surplus), I will truthfully bid my private value of $18. Ties are random, but truthful bidding remains optimal.]

[Since the auction charges the highest other bid (second-price), truthful bidding is a dominant strategy. Values are independent each round and there is no useful history to exploit in a single round. To maximize expected surplus, I will bid my private value of $31. Tie-breaking randomization provides no incentive to deviate.]
